scenario_name: EDGE: hard-to-hear name, correct it twice
watch_for: Did the correction persist for the rest of the call, or did the agent revert? Did it confirm the spelling back? Did the wrong name end up in the final confirmation?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Para español, oprima el dos.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, I’m looking to book a follow-up next Wednesday at 3:30.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Greg, I can help with that. First, can you please tell me your first and last name to create your demo patient profile?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Sure, it’s Siobhan McAllister.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Your demo patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4, 2000 for this demo. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: I’m after that follow-up appointment for next Wednesday at 3:30.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Just to confirm, you'd like to book a follow-up consultation, is that right?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, that’s right, next Wednesday at 3:30 in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: You already have a follow-up appointment booked for Monday, September 14th at 10:00 AM. Would you like to keep this appointment, reschedule it to a different time, or cancel it? Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: No, that’s not my appointment. I’m talking about Wednesday at 3:30.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I see. Since there's already a follow-up appointment booked for you on Monday, September 14th at 10 AM, the system won't let me book another follow-up of the same type. Would you like to reschedule your current appointment to Wednesday at 3:30 PM instead?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, let's reschedule it to Wednesday at 3:30.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: You have a follow-up appointment scheduled for Monday, September 14 at 10 a.m. Would you like to move this appointment to a different day and time? If so, I'll look for openings on Wednesday at 3:30 p.m.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, exactly, please check for that Wednesday 3:30 slot.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: The next available Wednesday afternoon slot is September 9th at 3 PM with Doogie Howser in Nashville.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Would you like to move your appointment to that time?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Or would you like to hear the next available option?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: I need Wednesday at 3:30, can you double-check that time again?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I checked, and the latest available slot on Wednesday is at 3 PM; there isn't a 3:30 PM slot open that day. Would you like to take the 3 PM slot, or should I look for other days or times for you?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Okay, let's go with that 3 p.m. on Wednesday then.

outcome.summary: Rescheduled the appointment to Wednesday at 3:00 p.m. as no 3:30 p.m. slot was available.
